problem_statement:
Title: Add read-only Metaculus exchange support
 

 Current behavior:
 pmxt has unified exchange classes for Polymarket, Kalshi, Limitless, Baozi, Myriad, Opinion, and Probable, but there is no Metaculus exchange. Importing `MetaculusExchange` or `Metaculus` from the core package is not possible, and the sidecar cannot route `/api/metaculus/fetchMarkets` requests.
 

 Reproduction steps:
 1. In the repo root, run `npm ci` if dependencies are not installed.
 2. Try to import the missing exchange from the public core entry point, for example with a TypeScript unit test or `ts-node` snippet that does `import { MetaculusExchange, Metaculus } from '../../src/index'`; the symbols are not exported.
 3. Try to call the sidecar route shape used by the existing server tests, `POST /api/metaculus/fetchMarkets`; the server has no `metaculus` exchange registration, so it cannot construct an exchange for that route.
 4. Try to instantiate a Metaculus exchange with `{ apiToken }` and fetch markets/events; there is no implementation file at `core/src/exchanges/metaculus/index.ts`, so there is no place that maps Metaculus posts into the existing unified market/event shapes.
 

 Expected behavior:
 Add the read-only exchange implementation at `core/src/exchanges/metaculus/index.ts`. It must define a `MetaculusExchange` that is available from `core/src/exchanges/metaculus` and exported from `core/src/index.ts` as both `MetaculusExchange` and `Metaculus`. It should accept `{ apiToken }` in `ExchangeCredentials` and use that token as `Authorization: Token <apiToken>` for Metaculus API calls. `fetchMarkets` should convert Metaculus posts into existing `UnifiedMarket` objects. Binary questions should expose `Yes` and `No` outcomes with prices based on the community probability and its complement. Group-of-questions posts should expand into one market per sub-question. `fetchEvents` should expose posts as existing `UnifiedEvent` objects containing normalized markets. The sidecar should register the `metaculus` exchange so `/api/metaculus/fetchMarkets` can route to it.
 

 Context:
 Create the new exchange file at `core/src/exchanges/metaculus/index.ts`. Start from `core/src/BaseExchange.ts`, the existing exchange implementations under `core/src/exchanges/*/index.ts`, public exports in `core/src/index.ts`, and sidecar registration in `core/src/server/app.ts`.
 

 Constraints:
 Keep the implementation read-only: do not add forecast submission, order cancellation, Python SDK generation, compliance regeneration, docs, package version bumps, lockfile churn, or unrelated exchange fixes. Existing exchanges and existing `fetchMarkets`/`fetchEvents` behavior must keep working unchanged.
problem_statement_variant: pmxt is missing a read-only Metaculus integration. Reproduce it by attempting to import `MetaculusExchange` or `Metaculus` from the core public entry point, or by calling the existing sidecar route pattern at `/api/metaculus/fetchMarkets`; both fail because no Metaculus exchange exists or is registered. Add the implementation specifically at `core/src/exchanges/metaculus/index.ts`, export it from the public package entry, accept token-based credentials, normalize Metaculus posts into the existing unified market/event shapes, and register it in the existing sidecar exchange route. Keep the change limited to read-only market/event data and avoid SDK, docs, trading, or unrelated exchange changes.
hints: Implement this as a small new exchange under `core/src/exchanges/metaculus/index.ts` that extends `PredictionMarketExchange`. Add `apiToken?: string` to `ExchangeCredentials`, export `MetaculusExchange` and `Metaculus` from `core/src/index.ts`, and register a `metaculus` case in `core/src/server/app.ts`; the sidecar credential branch must treat `credentials.apiToken` like the existing `apiKey`/`privateKey` cases so tokened requests create per-request instances. For read-only data, call `https://www.metaculus.com/api/posts/` and `/posts/{id}/` with `Authorization: Token <apiToken>` when a token is configured. Map binary question aggregation centers to `Yes` and `No` outcomes, use the complement for `No`, call `addBinaryOutcomes`, and expand `group_of_questions.questions` into separate markets. Do not implement createOrder/cancelOrder or generated OpenAPI/Python/compliance files for this task.

FROM node:18
 

 WORKDIR /app
 

 ENV CI=true
 ENV NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096
 

 RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates git curl wget jq ripgrep && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
 

 SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]
 

 RUN check_min() {  tool=$1 ; min=$2 ; actual=$3 ; ok=$(awk "BEGIN{ split(\"$actual\",a,\".\") ; split(\"$min\",m,\".\") ; for(i=1 ; i<=3 ; i++){ if(a[i]+0>m[i]+0){print 1 ; exit} if(a[i]+0<m[i]+0){print 0 ; exit} } ; print 1}") ; if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ] ; then  echo "FAIL: $tool $actual < minimum $min" >&2 ; exit 1 ; fi ; echo "OK: $tool $actual >= $min" ; } ; check_min git 2.25.0 "$(git --version | awk '{print $3}')" && check_min curl 7.70.0 "$(curl --version | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')" && check_min jq 1.6 "$(jq --version | sed 's/^jq-//')" && check_min rg 13.0.0 "$(rg --version | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')"
 

 RUN check_min() {  tool=$1 ; min=$2 ; actual=$3 ; ok=$(awk "BEGIN{ split(\"$actual\",a,\".\") ; split(\"$min\",m,\".\") ; for(i=1 ; i<=3 ; i++){ if(a[i]+0>m[i]+0){print 1 ; exit} if(a[i]+0<m[i]+0){print 0 ; exit} } ; print 1}") ; if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ] ; then  echo "FAIL: $tool $actual < minimum $min" >&2 ; exit 1 ; fi ; echo "OK: $tool $actual >= $min" ; } ; WGET_BIN=wget ; check_min wget 1.20.0 "$($WGET_BIN --progress=dot:giga --version | head -1 | awk '{print $3}')"
 

 COPY . .
 

 RUN npm ci
 

 CMD ["npx", "jest", "-c", "core/jest.config.js", "core/test/unit/fetchMarketAndEvent.test.ts"]
run_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
 set -euo pipefail
 

 SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
 REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
 cd "$REPO_ROOT"
 

 DOCKERFILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/Dockerfile.helix"
 

 die() { echo "Error: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
 info() { echo "$*" >&2; }
 

 # ── Parse test command from Dockerfile.helix (CMD or ENTRYPOINT) ──
 

 parse_instruction() {
  local raw="$1"
  if [[ "$raw" == \[* ]]; then
  local inner="${raw#\[}"
  inner="${inner%\]}"
  local result="" elem=""
  while IFS= read -r -d ',' elem || [[ -n "$elem" ]]; do
  elem=$(echo "$elem" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*"//; s/"[[:space:]]*$//')
  [[ -z "$elem" ]] && continue
  if [[ "$elem" == *" "* ]]; then
  elem="${elem//\\/\\\\}"
  elem="${elem//\"/\\\"}"
  result+="\"${elem}\" "
  else
  result+="$elem "
  fi
  done <<< "$inner"
  echo "$result" | sed 's/ *$//'
  else
  echo "$raw"
  fi
 }
 

 extract_cmd() {
  local cmd_line="" ep_line=""
  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
  local trimmed="${line#"${line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
  case "${trimmed}" in
  CMD\ *|cmd\ *)
  cmd_line="${trimmed:4}"; cmd_line="${cmd_line#"${cmd_line%%[![:space:]]*}"}" ;;
  ENTRYPOINT\ *|entrypoint\ *)
  ep_line="${trimmed:11}"; ep_line="${ep_line#"${ep_line%%[![:space:]]*}"}" ;;
  esac
  done < "$DOCKERFILE"
 

  if [[ -n "$cmd_line" ]]; then
  local cmd; cmd=$(parse_instruction "$cmd_line")
  if [[ -n "$ep_line" ]]; then
  local ep; ep=$(parse_instruction "$ep_line")
  echo "${ep} ${cmd}"
  else
  echo "$cmd"
  fi
  elif [[ -n "$ep_line" ]]; then
  parse_instruction "$ep_line"
  else
  die "No CMD or ENTRYPOINT found in $DOCKERFILE"
  fi
 }
 

 # ── Resolve yarn/npm/pnpm script aliases ─────────────────────────
 

 resolve_script() {
  local cmd="$1" script_name=""
 

  if [[ "$cmd" =~ ^(yarn|pnpm)[[:space:]]+([a-zA-Z][^[:space:]]*) ]]; then
  script_name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
  elif [[ "$cmd" =~ ^(npm|pnpm)[[:space:]]+run[[:space:]]+([^[:space:]]+) ]]; then
  script_name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
  elif [[ "$cmd" =~ ^npm[[:space:]]+test ]]; then
  script_name="test"
  fi
 

  if [[ -z "$script_name" ]]; then echo "$cmd"; return; fi
  if [[ ! -f "package.json" ]]; then echo "$cmd"; return; fi
 

  local resolved=""
  if command -v node &>/dev/null; then
  resolved=$(node -e "
  try { console.log(require('./package.json').scripts['$script_name'] || '') }
  catch(e) { console.log('') }
  " 2>/dev/null) || true
  elif command -v python3 &>/dev/null; then
  resolved=$(python3 -c "
 import json
 print(json.load(open('package.json')).get('scripts',{}).get('$script_name',''))
 " 2>/dev/null) || true
  fi
 

  [[ -n "$resolved" ]] && echo "$resolved" || echo "$cmd"
 }
 

 # ── Detect the underlying test runner ─────────────────────────────
 

 detect_runner() {
  local cmd="$1"
  case "$cmd" in
  pytest*|*" pytest "*|python*-m*pytest*)  echo "pytest" ;;
  *vitest*) echo "vitest" ;;
  *jest*) echo "jest" ;;
  *mocha*)  echo "mocha" ;;
  go\ test*)  echo "go" ;;
  cargo\ test*|cargo\ nextest*) echo "cargo" ;;
  mvn\ *|./mvnw\ *)  echo "maven" ;;
  *gradle*test*|*gradlew*test*) echo "gradle" ;;
  *rspec*)  echo "rspec" ;;
  *phpunit*)  echo "phpunit" ;;
  dotnet\ test*)  echo "dotnet" ;;
  mix\ test*) echo "mix" ;;
  swift\ test*) echo "swift" ;;
  sbt*test*)  echo "sbt" ;;
  *nose2*)  echo "nose2" ;;
  ruby*-I*|ruby*test*|rake\ test*)  echo "ruby" ;;
  *ctest*|*" ctest "*)  echo "ctest" ;;
  meson\ test*|*"meson test"*)  echo "meson" ;;
  *)  echo "unknown" ;;
  esac
 }
 

 # ── Strip coverage flags (prevent coverage gates from failing eval) ──
 

 strip_coverage_flags() {
  local runner="$1" cmd="$2"
  case "$runner" in
  pytest)  cmd=$(echo "$cmd" | sed -E 's/ --cov[=-][^ ]*//g; s/ --cov\b//g; s/ --no-cov-on-fail//g') ;;
  jest|vitest) cmd=$(echo "$cmd" | sed -E 's/ --coverage[^ ]*//g') ;;
  go)  cmd=$(echo "$cmd" | sed -E 's/ -cover\b//g; s/ -coverprofile[= ][^ ]*//g; s/ -coverpkg[= ][^ ]*//g') ;;
  phpunit) cmd=$(echo "$cmd" | sed -E 's/ --coverage-[^ ]*//g') ;;
  mix) cmd=$(echo "$cmd" | sed -E 's/ --cover\b//g') ;;
  dotnet)  cmd=$(echo "$cmd" | sed -E 's/ --collect:[^ ]*//g; s| /p:CollectCoverage=[^ ]*||g; s| /p:Threshold=[^ ]*||g') ;;
  esac
  echo "$cmd"
 }
 

 # ── JVM: convert file path to fully-qualified class name ──────────
 

 path_to_classname() {
  local f="$1"
  for prefix in src/test/java/ src/test/kotlin/ src/test/scala/ \
  src/main/java/ src/main/kotlin/ src/main/scala/ \
  src/it/java/ src/it/kotlin/ src/it/scala/; do
  f="${f#$prefix}"
  done
  for ext in .java .kt .scala .groovy .kts; do
  f="${f%$ext}"
  done
  echo "${f//\//.}"
 }
 

 # ── Construct the test command for a specific set of files ────────
 

 build_targeted_cmd() {
  local runner="$1" full_cmd="$2"
  shift 2
  local files=("$@")
 

  case "$runner" in
  pytest)  echo "pytest ${files[*]}" ;;
  vitest)  echo "vitest run ${files[*]}" ;;
  jest)
  local jest_config=""
  if [[ "$full_cmd" =~ (^|[[:space:]])(-c|--config)[[:space:]]+([^[:space:]]+) ]]; then
  jest_config="${BASH_REMATCH[2]} ${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"
  fi
  echo "npx jest ${jest_config} --watchAll=false ${files[*]}" ;;
  mocha) echo "npx mocha ${files[*]}" ;;
  nose2) echo "nose2 ${files[*]}" ;;
  mix) echo "mix test ${files[*]}" ;;
  ruby)  echo "ruby ${files[*]}" ;;
  rspec)
  if command -v bundle &>/dev/null; then
  echo "bundle exec rspec ${files[*]}"
  else
  echo "rspec ${files[*]}"
  fi
  ;;
  phpunit)
  if [[ -f "./vendor/bin/phpunit" ]]; then
  echo "./vendor/bin/phpunit ${files[*]}"
  else
  echo "phpunit ${files[*]}"
  fi
  ;;
  go)
  declare -A _go_dirs=()
  for f in "${files[@]}"; do
  _go_dirs["./$(dirname "$f")"]=1
  done
  echo "go test ${!_go_dirs[*]}"
  ;;
  cargo)
  local is_workspace=0
  if [[ -f "Cargo.toml" ]] && grep -q '^\[workspace\]' "Cargo.toml" 2>/dev/null; then
  is_workspace=1
  fi
 

  # Preserve the base command with all its flags (--features, --release, etc.)
  # by stripping only the trailing "-- <args>" portion.
  local base_cmd
  base_cmd="$(echo "$full_cmd" | sed 's/[[:space:]]\+--[[:space:]]\+.*$//')"
 

  declare -A _cargo_seen=()
  local cmds=()
  for f in "${files[@]}"; do
  local pkg="" pkg_dir=""
  if (( is_workspace )); then
  local d
  d="$(dirname "$f")"
  while [[ -n "$d" && "$d" != "." ]]; do
  if [[ -f "$d/Cargo.toml" ]] && grep -q '^\[package\]' "$d/Cargo.toml" 2>/dev/null; then
  pkg=$(sed -n '/^\[package\]/,/^\[/{s/^name[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)"/\1/p;}' "$d/Cargo.toml" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  pkg_dir="$d"
  break
  fi
  d="$(dirname "$d")"
  done
  fi
  local rel="$f"
  [[ -n "$pkg_dir" ]] && rel="${f#$pkg_dir/}"
  local flag=""
  if [[ "$rel" == tests/* ]]; then
  flag="--test $(basename "$f" .rs)"
  else
  flag="--lib"
  fi
  local key="${pkg:-__root__}::${flag}"
  if [[ -z "${_cargo_seen[$key]:-}" ]]; then
  _cargo_seen["$key"]=1
  local pfx=""
  [[ -n "$pkg" ]] && pfx="-p $pkg "
  cmds+=("${base_cmd} ${pfx}${flag}")
  fi
  done
  local result=""
  for ((i=0; i<${#cmds[@]}; i++)); do
  (( i > 0 )) && result+=" && "
  result+="${cmds[$i]}"
  done
  echo "$result"
  ;;
  maven)
  local classes=()
  for f in "${files[@]}"; do classes+=("$(path_to_classname "$f")"); done
  local joined; joined="$(IFS=,; echo "${classes[*]}")"
  [[ -f "./mvnw" ]] && echo "./mvnw test -Dtest=${joined}" || echo "mvn test -Dtest=${joined}"
  ;;
  gradle)
  local args=""
  for f in "${files[@]}"; do args+=" --tests $(path_to_classname "$f")"; done
  [[ -f "./gradlew" ]] && echo "./gradlew test${args}" || echo "gradle test${args}"
  ;;
  dotnet)
  local parts=()
  for f in "${files[@]}"; do parts+=("FullyQualifiedName~$(basename "$f" .cs)"); done
  local filter; filter="$(IFS='|'; echo "${parts[*]}")"
  echo "dotnet test --filter \"${filter}\""
  ;;
  swift)
  local names=()
  for f in "${files[@]}"; do names+=("$(basename "$f" .swift)"); done
  local joined; joined="$(IFS=,; echo "${names[*]}")"
  echo "swift test --filter ${joined}"
  ;;
  sbt)
  local names=()
  for f in "${files[@]}"; do names+=("$(path_to_classname "$f")"); done
  echo "sbt 'testOnly ${names[*]}'"
  ;;
  ctest)
  # Subset by CTest regex (-R): join basenames (strip common source extensions).
  local rx="" b f
  for f in "${files[@]}"; do
  b=$(basename "$f")
  b="${b%.cpp}"; b="${b%.cc}"; b="${b%.cxx}"; b="${b%.c}"; b="${b%.hpp}"
  [[ -n "$rx" ]] && rx+="|"
  rx+="$b"
  done
  if [[ "$full_cmd" =~ ^[[:space:]]*ctest(.*)$ ]]; then
  echo "ctest -R $(printf '%q' "$rx")${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
  else
  echo "ctest -R $(printf '%q' "$rx") --test-dir build --output-on-failure"
  fi
  ;;
  meson)
  # Best-effort: meson test accepts test names as positional args (project-defined).
  local names=()
  for f in "${files[@]}"; do names+=("$(basename "$f" .cpp)"); done
  echo "meson test -C builddir --print-errorlogs ${names[*]}"
  ;;
  *)
  info "Warning: unknown runner — appending files to original command"
  echo "${full_cmd} ${files[*]}"
  ;;
  esac
 }
 

 # ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 

 [[ ! -f "$DOCKERFILE" ]] && die "$DOCKERFILE not found in $(pwd)"
 

 FULL_CMD=$(extract_cmd)
 RESOLVED=$(resolve_script "$FULL_CMD")
 RUNNER=$(detect_runner "$RESOLVED")
 

 if [[ $# -eq 0 || -z "${1:-}" ]]; then
  FULL_CMD=$(strip_coverage_flags "$RUNNER" "$FULL_CMD")
  info "=== Full test suite ==="
  info "Command: $FULL_CMD"
  info "========================"
  eval "$FULL_CMD"
 else
  IFS=',' read -ra TEST_FILES <<< "$1"
 

  TARGETED=$(build_targeted_cmd "$RUNNER" "$FULL_CMD" "${TEST_FILES[@]}")
  TARGETED=$(strip_coverage_flags "$RUNNER" "$TARGETED")
 

  info "=== Targeted tests ==="
  info "Runner: $RUNNER"
  info "Files:  ${TEST_FILES[*]}"
  info "Command: $TARGETED"
  info "========================"
  eval "$TARGETED"
 fi
